stories.title: Foreign investors return to Indian equities
stories.summary: Foreign portfolio investors have infused ₹84,291 crore into Indian equities in November, marking a reversal from selling seen in most months this year. Market experts attribute the recovery to improving corporate earnings and attractive valuations. The market has decided that the previous months were merely a misunderstanding.

stories.title: Indian equity benchmarks extend weekly gains
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks extended gains for a third consecutive week, with the Nifty rising 0.46 percent and the Sensex 0.36 percent. Profit-booking late in the week pulled indices lower on Friday, settling the Sensex at 81,592. The market remains focused on foreign inflows and domestic fundamentals.

stories.title: PSU banks lead market rally
stories.summary: The Indian equity market extended gains for a third consecutive week, supported by foreign institutional buying, volatile crude prices, and retail inflation. Within the PSU Bank index, Punjab National Bank, Bank of India, and Bank of Baroda emerged as top contributors. The rally continues to find new participants.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty maintain winning streak
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks closed the week with modest gains, marking a third consecutive week of growth for the first time since June 2026. Relentless foreign buying of nearly ₹84,000 crore outweighed concerns over retail inflation breaching the RBI tolerance band. The market is currently ignoring the price of oil.

stories.title: Markets show stability after November recovery
stories.summary: Nifty and Sensex sustained higher levels throughout the week, with Nifty closing at 25,144 and Sensex at 81,592. Strong second-quarter earnings and lower crude oil prices supported the gains, while the Nifty Midcap 100 recorded a 3.6 percent surge. Stability is the current preferred market state.

stories.title: Foreign inflows fuel Indian market rebound
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 surged 11.3 percent over three weeks, driven by foreign inflows and the unwinding of bearish positions. Government hints regarding potential capital gains tax changes and a shift away from crowded AI trades in other Asian markets provided further support. The market has found five reasons to rally.

stories.title: Trade Setup For Nov 16: Nifty Likely To Resume Rally Despite Friday's Sell-Off, Key Levels To Watch - NDTV Profit
Nifty 50 logs third week of gains
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 ended in the green for the third consecutive week, supported by foreign inflows and corporate earnings. Benchmark indices have risen nearly 9.70 percent over the past month. Investors are now waiting to see if the streak can survive the next five days.

stories.title: Profit booking hits Indian benchmarks
stories.summary: After ten consecutive sessions of gains, the Sensex and Nifty witnessed profit booking, snapping a three-session winning streak on Friday. The Sensex declined 319 points to 81,592, while the Nifty fell 155 points to 25,144. Sustained foreign inflows helped the indices retain their overall weekly gains.

stories.title: Inflation and crude prices to steer markets
stories.summary: Analysts expect WPI inflation data, foreign investor activity, and crude oil prices to drive sentiment this week. Global focus remains on US retail sales and Nvidia earnings to shape rate expectations. The domestic calendar includes October WPI inflation and trade data. The market is preparing for a busy Monday.

stories.title: Key triggers for Indian stock markets
stories.summary: Analysts expect WPI inflation, foreign investor activity, and crude oil prices to drive sentiment this week. Global rate expectations will be shaped by US retail sales and FOMC minutes. Domestic trade data is scheduled for Monday. The market is currently monitoring several variables at once.

stories.title: Technical outlook remains constructive for Nifty
stories.summary: Despite Friday's decline, the Nifty 50 remains above the 25,000 mark. Analysts suggest a buy-on-dips strategy as long as support levels hold. The Sensex settled at 81,592.45 after an intraday fall. The market is testing its own resolve.

stories.title: Wall Street prepares for Nvidia and Anthropic
stories.summary: Investors are tracking Nvidia's quarterly earnings and the proposed IPO of Anthropic. These events, alongside Federal Reserve meeting minutes, are expected to influence sentiment. The market is looking for signs that AI infrastructure demand remains sustainable. Investors are watching the calendar closely.

stories.title: Nvidia and Anthropic face market tests
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell following reports regarding CEO Jensen Huang, ahead of a high-stakes quarterly report. Trading in Anthropic is expected to begin shortly, serving as a barometer for the AI trade. The market continues to evaluate risks including inflation and geopolitical tensions. Rose-colored glasses are currently in use.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs projects S&P 500 growth
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs expects the S&P 500 to reach 8,700 next year, citing attractive valuations despite slower earnings growth. The brokerage anticipates earnings growth rates will halve in 2027 as hyperscaler capital expenditure eases. The market is betting on a slowdown being a positive development.

stories.title: US Stock Market Week Ahead: Can Nvidia Earnings and Fed Minutes Spark a Nasdaq Rally? - Stocks Down Under
Markets react to potential Fed rate hike
stories.summary: CME FedWatch data indicates an 86.8 percent probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike in December. Investors reacted to October inflation data with volatility in Treasury yields and stock indices. The market is currently balancing rate expectations against AI stock performance.

stories.title: China tech stocks offer AI alternative
stories.summary: Opportunities in China are emerging within the AI supply chain. The sector is being viewed as a potential alternative for investors seeking exposure to artificial intelligence with less volatility. The market is looking for hardware in new places.

stories.title: How bonds got interesting again
stories.summary: Fixed income products are no longer the rank outsider they once were for those nearing retirement. Despite short-term market volatility, the asset class is seeing renewed interest as a viable component for long-term financial planning.

stories.title: What Europe’s rising public debt means for your portfolio
stories.summary: Hard-up governments across Europe are increasingly looking toward tax raids and spending cuts to manage rising public debt. Investors are now navigating how to adjust their portfolios in an environment where fiscal policy is shifting toward austerity.

stories.title: Wall Street’s wild ride delivers big paydays and bigger bruises
stories.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 have seen their largest average daily moves of the year in November. While some investors have secured windfalls, others have faced losses as market timing remains the primary factor in a period of violent reversals.

stories.title: Five world market themes for the week ahead
stories.summary: Anthropic's upcoming IPO is set to value the chatbot creator at $1.4 trillion, serving as a barometer for the AI trade. Meanwhile, Nvidia faces quarterly results following the abrupt resignation of its longtime CEO. The market is waiting to see if the AI sector remains sustainable.

stories.title: AI rockets to top of financial system worries
stories.summary: Eighty-seven percent of contacts in the latest Federal Reserve survey cited AI as a salient risk to the financial system, up from 50 percent in May. Respondents pointed to potential cyberattacks, complex financing risks, and the possibility of a broad market correction triggered by an earnings slowdown.

stories.title: Fed policymakers wait for more data
stories.summary: Federal Reserve policymakers voted 10-2 in October to wait for additional data before considering a rate hike. Officials noted that while economic activity remains solid, persistent inflation readings provide the most important signal for determining the appropriate future stance of monetary policy.

stories.title: RBI repo rate increase appears certain
stories.summary: Retail inflation projections have pushed the real repo rate into negative territory, making a policy-rate adjustment necessary. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to act in December, with the extent of the hike depending on future inflation forecasts and the desired level of the real policy rate.

stories.title: Inflation breaches RBI tolerance limit
stories.summary: Retail inflation hit 6.09 percent in October, breaching the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6 percent for the first time in two years. The rise reflects global supply chain shocks, a below-average monsoon, and the fading impact of previous price-reduction measures.

stories.title: RBI unlikely to ease 50% FOIR limit for microfinance loans, says deputy governor Murmu - Moneycontrol.com
RBI may review microfinance income threshold
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India may consider reviewing the 3 lakh annual household income threshold for microfinance borrowers. Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu stated that any revision will depend on the regulator's assessment of industry developments and the specific needs of the sector.

stories.title: RBI flags a rise in microloan costs, calls for ‘fair and competitive lending rates’ - Telegraph India
RBI warns MFIs on responsible lending
stories.summary: Microfinance institutions must exercise responsible lending as borrowers remain vulnerable to climate-related risks and geopolitical tensions, according to RBI Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu. He noted that these low-income households are disproportionately affected by global uncertainties that fall outside the reach of traditional banking.

stories.title: IDBI Bank unions oppose Fairfax stake sale
stories.summary: IDBI Bank unions have urged the Reserve Bank of India to withhold approval for the proposed transfer of management control to Fairfax Financial Holdings. The unions are seeking an independent review of the transaction, citing concerns over valuation, employee safeguards, and the interests of depositors.

stories.title: IDBI Bank sale: Union urges RBI to block Fairfax takeover - The Indian Express

stories.title: Yes Bank seeks review of AT-1 bond write-off
stories.summary: Yes Bank has petitioned the Supreme Court to review an order that upheld a ruling to quash the write-off of 8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds. These perpetual instruments, which carry higher interest rates than traditional bonds, were cancelled during the bank's previous financial difficulties.

stories.title: RBI mandates six-hour cyber incident reporting
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India now requires non-bank payment system operators to report cyberattacks, system outages, and settlement delays within six hours of detection. The directive aims to enable quicker regulatory intervention and strengthen cybersecurity monitoring across the digital payments ecosystem.

stories.title: RBI tightens reporting for payment firms
stories.summary: Non-banking payment system operators must report unusual incidents to the Reserve Bank of India and the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team within six hours. The revised guidelines also introduce stricter controls on vendors and mandate annual audits to combat digital payment disruptions.

stories.title: Regulators hold cybersecurity session for banks
stories.summary: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre, the RBI, and FACE held a cybersecurity awareness session for over 400 participants from the banking and fintech sectors. The event focused on emerging threats and security risks associated with payout application programming interfaces.

stories.title: Paytm receives preliminary approval to restart digital wallet business
stories.summary: Paytm has received preliminary approval from the Reserve Bank of India to issue prepaid payment instruments through its subsidiary, Paytm Payments Services. The move marks a step toward rebuilding a business disrupted by regulatory action two years ago. Final authorisation is still required before services can resume.

stories.title: RBI grants in-principle approval for Paytm wallet revival
stories.summary: Paytm has received in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India to restart its digital wallet business. The company must complete an independent systems and cybersecurity audit and submit findings to the central bank within six months to secure final clearance. Approval does not permit an immediate relaunch.

stories.title: RBI fines MobiKwik for regulatory violations
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has imposed a 9 lakh rupee penalty on One MobiKwik Systems for non-compliance with prepaid payment instrument norms and delayed fraud reporting. The fine follows a statutory inspection of the company’s operations conducted between June 2025 and March 2026.

stories.title: Razorpay receives SEBI approval for IPO
stories.summary: Razorpay has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India to proceed with its initial public offering. The fintech firm is expected to raise approximately 600 million dollars through the issue, five months after it confidentially filed draft papers with the market regulator.

stories.title: Razorpay IPO cleared for 2027 listing
stories.summary: Razorpay has received regulatory observations on its draft IPO papers, allowing the company to proceed with a public issue expected to raise up to 630 million dollars. The listing is anticipated between January and March 2027, potentially valuing the fintech firm at approximately 5 billion dollars.

stories.title: MobiKwik penalised for fraud reporting failures
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has fined One MobiKwik Systems 9 lakh rupees for violating regulations regarding prepaid payment instruments and fraud reporting. The penalty follows a supervisory inspection that identified irregularities in fund transfers and failures to report fraud incidents within the prescribed timeframe.

stories.title: RBI issues penalty to One MobiKwik Systems
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has imposed a 9 lakh rupee penalty on One MobiKwik Systems for non-compliance with regulatory norms. The fine follows a statutory inspection of the company's operations covering the period from June 2025 to March 2026.

stories.title: Mufin Green Finance secures forex licence
stories.summary: Mufin Green Finance has received an Authorised Dealer Category-II licence from the Reserve Bank of India. The NBFC plans to use the authorisation to offer fee-based services, including foreign exchange conversion and outward remittances for education and medical treatment, to diversify its revenue streams.

stories.title: UPI network marks ten years of operations
stories.summary: The Unified Payments Interface has completed ten years of operations under the regulatory oversight of the Reserve Bank of India. Launched in 2016, the network is now operational in 11 countries and serves as the backbone of India's digital payments ecosystem.

stories.title: NPCI committee to review UPI merchant charges
stories.summary: An NPCI-led committee will determine the future of the merchant discount rate for UPI transactions. The government clarified that person-to-person money transfers will remain free of cost, noting that recent legislative amendments are intended to ensure the long-term sustainability and technological resilience of the platform.

stories.title: Punjab National Bank partners with Zaggle for credit cards
stories.summary: Punjab National Bank has partnered with Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services to launch co-branded twin credit cards. The cards are manufactured using biodegradable materials, reflecting a shared commitment to environmental stewardship while providing lifestyle benefits to consumers.

stories.title: NPCI launches incentive scheme for UPI merchant expansion
stories.summary: The NPCI has launched the UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme to pay banks for deploying QR codes and soundboxes at new small merchant locations. The initiative will be funded by a slice of the merchant discount rate that banks are set to earn on future UPI payments.

stories.summary: Investors putting money into the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (MIS) for a regular income should pay attention to what happens to the interest they leave unclaimed. stories.title: Loan guarantees carry personal financial risk
stories.summary: Agreeing to become a loan guarantor is often presented as a simple favour to friends or family. In reality, a guarantor assumes full financial responsibility for the debt if the borrower defaults. Missed payments by the borrower will directly impact the guarantor's own credit score.

stories.title: Bank holiday schedule for November 16 to 22
stories.summary: Banks including SBI, HDFC, ICICI and PNB will observe regional and weekly closures between November 16 and November 22. The Reserve Bank of India calendar notes closures for Chhath Puja and Igas-Bagwal. Customers are advised to check local branch status before planning visits.

stories.title: Bank branches to close for three days between November 16 and 22
stories.summary: Public and private sector lenders will be closed for three days during the week of November 16 to 22, according to the Reserve Bank of India. While in-branch services will be unavailable, digital banking platforms are expected to remain operational throughout the holiday period.

stories.title: Tax implications for gifts of movable property
stories.summary: Not all gifts of movable property are tax-exempt. Items such as jewellery, shares and gold can be taxable depending on their value and the source of the gift. Purchasing assets below market value may also trigger tax liabilities. Only specific capital assets fall under these rules.

stories.title: Comparing mutual fund SIPs and Post Office RDs
stories.summary: Investing 10,000 rupees monthly for five years yields different results depending on the chosen vehicle. Mutual fund SIPs offer market-linked returns with associated risks, while Post Office Recurring Deposits provide predictable returns during market volatility. The final corpus depends entirely on the chosen investment strategy.

stories.title: Income Tax Department launches FAST-DS 2026 scheme
stories.summary: The Income Tax Department has introduced the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme to allow voluntary reporting of previously undisclosed foreign assets. Eligible taxpayers must submit Form 1 by December 31, 2026. The scheme aims to increase transparency and boost tax compliance among residents.
